method: Ran `<cli> --help` AND every advertised subcommand's `--help` on each competitor CLI INSTALLED ON THIS MACHINE, counted mentions of verif/proof/receipt/attest/evidence, then READ every hit rather than trusting the count. A positive control (loki, 4 hits) confirms the probe is not silently broken.
claim: No installed competitor CLI exposes a command that verifies the agent's OWN output. Loki does.
not_claimed: Devin, Replit Agent and 8090 ship no local CLI, so they are NOT covered and no claim is made about them. Absence from a --help listing is not proof of absence from a product: a web UI or an API could expose something the CLI does not. This measures the CLI surface only.

results.note: All hits are --verify-ssl (SSL cert validation) and --git-commit-verify (git hook control), neither of which verifies aider's own output.
Factory AI's CLI. 7 subcommands searched in addition to top-level help; zero verification-surface hits anywhere.
